registration.matter: Inviscid barotropic Euler fluid, Newtonian inertial coupling, instantaneous registered static gravitational field.
registration.equilibrium: Diagnostic source-specific P(r)=integral_r^infinity rho g dr; cs^2=Pprime/rhoprime=-rho g/rhoprime.
registration.displacement: xi=-delta_psi_prime/(4 pi G rho), compact on 1<r<3.
registration.numerator: -integral r^2 cs^2 delta_rho^2/rho dr + integral r^2 delta_psi_prime delta_g dr/(4 pi G).
registration.denominator: integral r^2 rho xi^2 dr; angular factor 4pi cancels.
registration.scope: Conditional Rayleigh quotients for selected trial displacements. Source-specific EOS, not a universal law; global equilibrium and full spectrum not certified.
